name: Hinata Eli Firth
original_name: 日向 エリ ファース
source:
2nd year high school student.
Hinata is [url=/c24824]Sejm's[/url] older twin brother. The secretary of the student council, he is is softhearted and timid honour student. He's well-versed in the school's various documents and records. Hinata excels in healing magic.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.p-reve.com/goes/#!/chara]official website profile[/URL].]
